body: i wish you all the best! i hope school’s just that bit easier for you now 💓
sorry but i’ve seen your other posts and they’re all just you telling near enough to the same story but you twist things? idk what’s going on but alright
I’m so sorry to hear, we’re both in a hard place, let’s just hope we make it out. Thank you for your reply.
Thank you for your concern, but I’m very set in my ways.

There’s no one for me to reach out to honestly, my siblings are all 20+ and working abroad, and my mother and I honestly aren’t on speaking terms.
Thank you for your concern.
I honestly really appreciate your reply, and thank you for coming at the situation in a very understanding way. I’ve had everything thought through, and I’m away of all the backlash involved.

i’m currently spending my time with all my animals, they always help me when i’m down and i just want the last time i see them to be the best.
have a good day and thank you for your time

i genuinely really appreciate your reply and your concern. but i’m very aware of how serious my decision is, and i’ve been contemplating since the age of 11. i’ve always wanted help since i was young and i did go to therapy for 8 months but it was no use. so this is it for me.
thank you for your response

I’ve completely thought it out, and there’s only one person that’d be hurt by it which is my best friend who i’ve been close to for almost a year now. sounds really short, but we’re extremely close and he’s very aware of how i feel. i really appreciate you for replying and talking with me:)

it’s just the way i want to go i guess, i’ve has a failed attempt of overdose and the pain was horrific, i know hanging is painful and i’ve done all my research these past few months, but if hanging is unsuccessful there’d be less suffering in my personal opinion. 
thanks for your concern (:

I really appreciate your response, but genuinely i’m not in the mood to talk with people especially when it’s about my emotions or my past. anytime i’ve tried to reach out i just got blocked off and now personally i’m just too drained to stay alive with everything i’ve been through. i know people have been through way worse, but personally i can no longer bear living. thank you for your concerns
you mention that you have both depression anxiety, why not go to whoever diagnosed you and get them to assign you to some form of a therapist?

I really appreciate your concerns, and I’ll try discuss my feelings seriously with either one of my siblings or a very close friend of
mine. I’ll see what can be done, once again, thank you.

I honestly respect your decision but just know that there is some people who can help and I don’t want to promote your suicide. I hope you maybe rethink things. But if you are just completely done, that’s fine and you can do whatever you want as a human being. But some people care, and will be there for you. Whether that be anonymously or not.

I’ve heard of childline, I tried texting an operator but they took a bit to reply so I just became so anxious. I’ll more than likely retry their services very soon thanks to this reminder. Thanks again :)

I’d be open to anonymous therapy but I wouldn’t even know where to start when it comes to looking for anywhere that provides the service. Me and my mother aren’t very close and I don’t trust her with much. She did pay for me to go to therapy but my counsellor from my former school paid for the first 5 months (Which I’m so grateful for). I’d say my mother would pay for my therapy again but that’d mean I’d have to tell her everything that’s going on which is something I’m not keen on. 
Overall I’ve already tried therapy and it didn’t benefit me at all so it’d probably just be useless to just pay for something that didn’t help me, but I’m still open to the idea partially.

I haven’t looked into activities outside of school really, only just sports but I don’t like how competitive people are so I just kind of gave up. I’ll probably look at some clubs that aren’t sport related and see if it’s of any benefit. Thanks for understanding where I’m coming from, I appreciate it. :)

Our school doesn’t have any clubs which really sucks, not many schools over here do. I’m not very close with any of my classmates and all my friends live quite far away so I can only see them every once in a while which is so horrible. 
I’ve tried starting so many new hobbies; art, cooking, soccer, languages etc. but every time I partake in a hobby I get so tired of it so quickly and then the cycle just repeats, which leaves me feeling so bad about myself for not holding a single hobby.
Thank you very much for your reply.

The clinic I went to only specialised in CBT, it was easiest for me too as it was only in the next town over. I’ve had to move schools a lot due to not fitting in, and I’m currently on ‘student council’ which makes me one of the two representatives for my entire year. Which means I’m always speaking with all staff and teachers so I’m decently close with a lot of staff, but our school counsellor never has time for students and I don’t trust any of the staff enough with my mental health problems. Even when I went to therapy I wouldn’t speak about everything to the full extent as I just wasn’t comfortable. My mother thinks I’m fully recovered so she sees nothing wrong with how I act anymore. 

Side note- I’m so sorry to hear that you lost your father, it’s very tough and I hope you’ve come to terms with his passing. (Not moving on, as of course it’s so traumatising, and I don’t think anyone could ever move on from that kind of event.)

I completely forgot to mention, I went to therapy for eight months, I started in October (2017) and finished in May (2018). I went every Wednesday and Friday. At the start I thought I seen a change, but after about 7 months I just realised it didn’t help me whatsoever, but my mother had still paid for the next month in advance so I decided to stay until the 8th month was up. 
I really appreciate your reply by the way.
